about: Byte patches to the game's arm64 program library. Each site is checked before it is changed; if the library or any site differs, nothing is patched. Text sites include the text's end byte, and a shorter replacement is padded with zero bytes so every string keeps its place.

patches.why: The built-in login server addresses (five region entries) point at the local server.

The game login (opcode 3) sends the local session token in the field that held the device id: the call to the device-id getter becomes a call to the platform-token getter at 0x02a2c050 with the login system as its argument (x19 into x0; two no-ops; the result pointer x8 and x19 stay as they were).
Four log lines that would print the session token print a fixed text instead.
Redact the logout credential. The aligned tail after the new text terminator holds the 24-byte leaderboard-entry helper; it was already cleared by this redaction. See leaderboard-refresh.S.

before.text: Native logout. Do logout online player. Now uid:[%s]

patches.why: Before registering leaderboard callbacks, clear RankSystem cached pages once, then execute the original notifier getter and resume OnEnter. See leaderboard-refresh.S.
Send chat to the local server at every level so slash commands work on new characters. Session.socialRoute retains property 298 for ordinary messages. See admin-chat.S.
